description:
Watch the character reveal trailer for Mortal Kombat II, the upcoming action fantasy sequel based on the legendary fighting game franchise.

The new film brings Earthrealm and Outworld back into brutal conflict, expanding the tournament with fan-favorite fighters including Johnny Cage, Kitana, Jade, Shao Kahn, Scorpion, Noob Saibot, Liu Kang, Sonya Blade, Raiden, Baraka, Quan Chi, and more.

Mortal Kombat II releases May 8, 2026.

Starring Karl Urban, Lewis Tan, Jessica McNamee, Mehcad Brooks, Ludi Lin, Tati Gabrielle, Adeline Rudolph, Martyn Ford, Joe Taslim, Hiroyuki Sanada, Tadanobu Asano, Chin Han, and Damon Herriman.
